notes: AVANT-PROPOS, page - 1 -, I. This typescript states the programme of Weil cohomology through étale topology, torsion prime to residual characteristics, and passage to l-adic coefficients. It lists spectral sequences, finiteness, Künneth, duality and Lefschetz, and announces comparison over C. The inserted references are SGA 1964/65 and SGA 1965; they are references on the sheet, not a separately supplied date. The page ends mid-sentence. The footnote expressly says « il n’est pas prouvé » that Frobenius eigenvalues are algebraic integers, « ni à fortiori » that their absolute values equal q^(i/2); no later result is imported. Source forms « dûs », « A partir », singular « coefficient » and the visible dots remain. The repeated l-adic notation decides the l/1 ambiguity; the repeated limiting index decides nu/v. The long diagonal is reproduced continuously; its intended cancellation scope remains uncertain, and the text beneath it is fully transcribed. No theorem asserted here has been proved in this reading.
